persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: jaya jitāmitramallavarmmaṇā svakarena likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ ... jitāmitrasya bhūpasya ... jaya jitāmitramalladevasana

date.as_written: śrīnepālasamvat 805 || śrīkarigata samvat 4785 || śrīvikramāditya samvat 1741 || śrīśake samvat 1606 || māghamāse, śuklapakṣa || śrīpaṇcamyāyātithai || revati nakṣete || śubhayoge || yathākarana mūhūtake || bṛhaspativāśale

purpose: pūjāpaddhati prepared in connection with offering a large bell (tavagvaḍa ghaṃṭā) to Nāṭeśvara Mahābhairava
notes: King Jayajitāmitramalla of Bhaktapur wrote the manuscript with his own hand (svakarena likhitaṃ) and compiled the paddhati from multiple texts (nānā granthasa soyāva pūjāpaddhati saṃphuḍi mahākastana dayakā). Bhāgīrāma was the prominent minister/administrator in Bhaktapur under his reign.
